The adoption event is tomorrow and we need all hands on deck. We're short on volunteers and there's a lot to be done. It's urgent that everyone who said they'd help gets in touch now to confirm their availability.

subject: ASAP: Missing Cat
body:
Hi, 
I'm so worried! My cat, Whiskers, went missing last night. Could you help me look for him? It's really urgent, I need your help today to find him.

subject: Urgent: Pet Medical Supplies
body:
Hi, 
The local pet store is out of stock on key medical supplies we need for our clinic. We need to find an alternative supplier quickly to avoid a critical shortage. Can you please look into this urgently and get back to me with any leads today?

subject: ASAP: Pet Care Volunteer Needed
body:
Hi, 
We're in need of a pet care volunteer to help at our shelter this weekend. It's a last-minute request, but we're really in need. Can you please let me know if you're available as soon as possible? This is urgent and we need a quick response.

subject: URGENT: Pet Transport
body:
Hi Team, 
We have a critical situation. We need to transport a batch of animals urgently to a new shelter. Can someone step up to help with this? We need to act fast to avoid any potential harm to the animals. This is a critical situation and needs immediate attention.

subject: ASAP: Urgent Vet Visit
body:
Hi, 
My cat is showing signs of a severe allergic reaction. We need to get her to the vet as soon as possible. Could you help me arrange this? It's really urgent and I need your help now.

subject: Urgent: Pet Food Drive
body:
Hi, 
We're organizing a food drive for pets in need and we need your help. We're short on volunteers and time is running out. Can everyone please spread the word and help us collect as much food as possible by this weekend? This is urgent, we need your help now.

subject: ASAP: Pet Rescue Mission
body:
Hi, 
We have a rescue mission planned for tomorrow and we need everyone to be ready. It's a last-minute request, but we're short on volunteers and time is running out. Can you please confirm your availability and get ready for the mission? This is urgent and we need a quick response.

subject: Urgent: Pet Adoption Application
body:
Hi, 
The adoption application for Max, the puppy, needs to be completed by tomorrow to avoid losing him to another family. It's urgent, can you please fill it out and send it back to us asap? We need your help now.

subject: ASAP: Pet Medication Refill
body:
Hi, 
I need to refill the prescription for my cat's medication. The pharmacy isn't answering and it's urgent we get it today. Could you please help me find another pharmacy that can deliver it today? This is really critical.

subject: Urgent: Pet Care Instructions
body:
Hi, 
I'm leaving town tomorrow and need someone to take care of my pets. I've prepared a list of instructions, but it's urgent that you confirm you can follow them before I leave. Can you please confirm asap? This is really important.

subject: ASAP: Urgent Pet Transfer
body:
Hi, 
We need to transfer a batch of dogs to a new shelter asap. The current shelter is overcrowded and the dogs are at risk. Can you help coordinate this transfer and make sure it's done safely and quickly? This is urgent and we need your help now.

subject: Urgent: Pet Training Session
body:
Hi Team, 
We have an urgent training session for our volunteers tomorrow. It's critical everyone attends to ensure we can provide the best care possible. Can you please confirm your attendance and be ready by 9am sharp? This is urgent and we need everyone's participation.

subject: ASAP: Emergency Pet Supplies
body:
Hi, 
We're in desperate need of emergency supplies for the pet shelter. The last shipment was delayed and we're running low. We need to act fast to ensure the animals are well cared for. Can you please help us secure these supplies asap? This is urgent and we need a quick response.

subject: Immediate Action Required - Rover's Missing!
body: Hey there! I just got a call from the vet - they found a dog matching Rover's description, but they need to confirm his identity. Can you head there ASAP to see if it's him? This is urgent.

subject: Urgent: Kitty Needs Medication
body: Hi, could you please pick up the medication for kitty from the vet on your way home? It's a new prescription and I need to start her on it as soon as possible. It's urgent, please let me know you got it.

subject: Your Pet's Checkup is Overdue
body:
Dear Customer,
We noticed that your pet's last checkup was 3 months ago. Please schedule an appointment within the next 7 days. Failure to do so will result in a missed SLA and additional fees.
Best,
Pet Health Clinic

subject: Emergency Vet Visit for Whiskers
body: Hello, my friend! Whiskers has been vomiting all morning and is not acting like himself. The vet thinks it might be something serious. Can you please come with me to the vet? It's urgent, we need to leave by 3pm.

subject: Critical Update: Pet Insurance Claim
body: Urgent: Your recent pet insurance claim has been rejected. We need to resubmit the correct forms by the end of the day today to avoid a delay in coverage. Please provide the necessary documents immediately.

subject: Urgent Notice: Dog Park Closure
body: Important Update: The local dog park has been closed due to an outbreak of canine parvovirus. Please keep your dog away from the area and contact your vet if you notice any symptoms. This is critical, please share this info with other pet owners.

subject: Rush Order for Pet Supplies
body:
Hi there,
I need to get a rush order of pet supplies to the store by the end of day today. Can you place it for me? It's urgent, I have a client waiting for it.
Thanks,
John

subject: Urgent Pet Food Recall
body:
Dear Customer,
We are currently experiencing a recall on a specific batch of pet food. If you purchased this batch, please return it immediately. This is urgent to ensure the health of your pets.
Best,
Pet Food Supplier

subject: Urgent: Pet Sitting Cancellation
body: Hi, I'm sorry for the inconvenience, but I've had to cancel your pet sitting reservation for next weekend. There was an emergency that requires me to be out of town. I know this is short notice, but it's critical that I handle this situation as soon as possible.

subject: ASAP: Pet Adoption Decision
body:
Hi,
I just received a call from the shelter - they found a perfect match for you. Can you come see them today? We need to make a decision by the end of the week, this is urgent. Let me know if you can make it.

subject: Immediate Response Required - Pet Health Issue
body:
Hello,
We're currently experiencing a critical issue with one of our pets. They are showing signs of illness and we need immediate advice from your team. This cannot wait, please respond as soon as possible.
Best,
Pet Care Team

subject: Emergency Vet Visit Needed
body:
Hey,
I just got off the phone with the vet and they said we need to bring Fluffy in right away. They think she might have ingested something toxic. We need to leave now, can you watch the house? This is urgent.

subject: Urgent: Pet Training Session Cancellation
body:
Hello,
Due to unforeseen circumstances, I have to cancel today's pet training session. It's urgent that you reschedule as we have a tight timeline to prepare for the competition next week. Please let me know when you're available.

subject: ASAP: Pet Grooming Appointment
body:
Hi there,
We noticed your pet's next grooming appointment is overdue. Please book the next available slot as soon as possible. We're running behind schedule and it's critical that we catch up.

subject: Urgent: Pet Food Delivery Issue
body:
Dear Customer,
We apologize for the delay in your pet food delivery. We have encountered an issue with the supplier and are working to resolve it. However, we need your immediate assistance to confirm a new delivery date. This is urgent to ensure your pet's supply is uninterrupted.
Best,
Pet Supplies Co.

subject: Immediate: Pet ID Tag Request
body:
Hi,
We noticed that your pet doesn't have an ID tag. It's urgent that you get one before we go to the beach next weekend. Can you pick one up at the pet store? Please let me know if you can get it done by Wednesday.

subject: Urgent: Pet Adoption Follow-Up
body:
Hi,
We're following up on a recent pet adoption. Can you please provide us with the necessary forms by the end of the day today? It's urgent to complete the adoption process as soon as possible.
Thanks,
Adoption Coordinator

subject: Urgent: Pet Caregiver Change
body:
Hi there,
Due to a change in our schedule, we need to switch our pet's caregiver immediately. Can you please update the system with the new information? This is urgent to ensure smooth pet care operations.
Best,
Pet Care Manager

subject: ASAP: Pet Medication Reminder
body:
Hi,
I just remembered that you need to give your pet's medication this evening. It's urgent that you don't forget as it's part of their treatment plan. Please set a reminder to ensure you give it on time.
Thanks,
Your Vet

subject: Urgent: Pet Adoption Decision Update
body:
Hello,
We have a new update from the shelter. They found an ideal pet for you. Can you come see them today? We need to make a decision by the end of the week. This is urgent as they're being adopted out quickly.

subject: Puppy at Vet - Immediate Help Needed
body: Tommy is in critical condition at the vet. He needs a blood transfusion and they can't do it without finding a compatible donor. Could you help find someone who can donate? This can't wait, please call Dr. Smith at 555-1234 immediately.

subject: Urgent: Cat Poisoning
body: Our cat, Whiskers, just ate something toxic. The vet said we need to induce vomiting asap. Could you meet me at the clinic right away? We're running out of time.

subject: Dog Walkers Needed ASAP
body: Our dog walker got sick and can't make it today. If you could fill in, it would be a huge help. The dog needs to be walked by 4 pm at the latest. Let me know if you're free.

subject: Rabbit Escaped - Critical
body: I just noticed my rabbit, Bun-Bun, has escaped. He's been missing for 15 minutes now. If you see him, please contact me right away. It's a matter of urgency.

subject: Pet Grooming Emergency
body: Our groomer's computer crashed and all appointments for this week are lost. I have to find someone who can groom my dog today before we go to the beach. Is there anyone you know who can help?

subject: Fish Tank Malfunction
body: The water in my fish tank is turning green and the fish aren't looking well. I need to get this sorted before dinner time or I fear I'll lose all my fish. Have you any advice?

subject: Urgent: Exotic Pet Sitter Needed
body: We're going out of town for an emergency and our pet tarantula needs care. We have to find someone to watch her by noon today. She's very sensitive and needs a specific diet. Could you find someone reliable?

subject: Parrot in Distress
body: Our parrot, Polly, is making unusual sounds and seems very upset. I'm worried she might be sick or hurt. Could you come over and help me check on her? We need to figure out what's wrong before she gets worse.

subject: Dog Food Recall
body: There's a recall on the brand of dog food we feed our puppy. She needs to be switched immediately to avoid any health issues. Do you know a good store nearby that has a suitable alternative?

subject: Raccoon in the House
body: A raccoon somehow got into our house and is causing a mess. It's in the kitchen and we're afraid it might hurt someone or damage something. If you have any ideas on how to safely get it out, we need your help quickly.

subject: Hamster Wheel Broken
body: My hamster's wheel broke and he's been stuck in his cage for hours. If you could bring a spare wheel today, it would be a big relief. I don't want him to get stressed.

subject: Lost Turtle
body: I'm worried my turtle, Shelly, may have escaped from her tank. I've looked everywhere but can't find her. Can you check your yard or garden in case she's hiding there?

subject: Emergency Vet Visit Required
body: I just realized my pet lizard has a bad skin infection and it looks like he's in a lot of pain. The vet says we need to take him in right away for treatment. Could you help transport him to the clinic? We're already running late.

subject: Urgent: Cat in Tree
body: My cat, Fluffy, climbed up a tall tree and she's scared and won't come down. We need to get her out by evening or we're concerned she might fall. Do you know anyone who can help?

subject: Pet Insurance Claim Overdue
body: I need to submit an urgent pet insurance claim for my rabbit's recent medical expenses by the end of the day. Could you give me a hand with the paperwork? It's crucial we don't miss the deadline.

subject: Snake Handler Needed Immediately
body: Our snake got loose in the house and we're not sure where it is. We need someone skilled to come and catch it quickly. This is an emergency, can you recommend someone?

subject: Urgent: Pet Store Closed
body: I need to buy more food for my birds before the pet store closes. Could you go and pick up a bag for me? We're running low and I don't want to risk their health.

subject: Bird Feeder Problem
body: The bird feeder I just bought is leaking and the birds are getting wet. I need advice on how to fix it or replace it. Could you give me some pointers or maybe help me out?

subject: Hamster Not Eating
body: My hamster hasn't eaten all day and seems lethargic. I'm very worried. Could you give me a call or drop by to check if anything is wrong? We need to act fast.

subject: Urgent: Cat Rescue
body: I found a stray cat in the street and it looks hurt. I need someone to take it to the vet right away. It's urgent, we're at the clinic but need someone with a car to help out.

subject: Urgent: Milo's Missing!
body: I just got home and Milo is gone! He's never left the house before. I've looked everywhere. Can you help me search the neighborhood? This can't wait.

subject: Pet Emergency: Oliver Injured!
body: Oliver was playing in the backyard and got a cut. I've cleaned it up but I'm not sure if it needs stitches. Could you take a look or bring him to the vet? Please call me back ASAP.

subject: Overdue: Pet Supplies
body: We've been using up supplies and I haven't had a chance to order more. We're running low on food and toys. Could you handle this by the end of today? We can't afford to run out.

subject: Critical: Tank's Tank Broken
body: The aquarium for my Betta fish, Tank, just broke. He needs a new one before 3pm today or we'll have to return him to the store. Can you pick one up quickly? It's urgent.

subject: Urgent Request for Help
body: I'm at work and can't take care of my cat, Luna, today. I'm trying to get her to the vet but traffic is insane. Could you meet me there and help? It's really important.

subject: Immediate: Koko's Illness Escalation
body: I noticed Koko's condition has worsened since last night. He's been vomiting and acting lethargic. This is beyond what I can handle at home. Please come over as soon as you can.

subject: ASAP: Daisy Needs a Walk
body: I'm running late from work and Daisy hasn't been walked since morning. She gets anxious if she doesn't move. Could you come over and take her out? It's crucial she gets exercise.

subject: Urgent: Hamster Wheel Repair
body: Hammy's wheel just fell apart and he's pacing in his cage. I have to fix it before he gets injured. Do you know where to buy a new one or can you bring me one? I need a solution today.

subject: Mild Urgency: Purrfect Kitty Playdate
body: My kitten, Whiskers, hasn't played in a while and I think she needs a friend. We're planning a playdate with another cat. Could you confirm you can bring Fluffy over today?

subject: High Urgency: Fido's Medication Refill
body: Fido's medication is almost gone and his next dose is due tonight. I haven't been able to contact the vet yet. Could you pick up a refill and bring it over by the 5pm meeting? It's critical he gets his meds on time.

subject: ASAP: Spot's Behavior Change
body: Spot's behavior has changed suddenly. He's been destructive and won't eat. I'm worried and need advice. Can you come over and help me figure out what's going on? It can't wait.

subject: Urgent: Featherball's Feathers Falling
body: Featherball's feathers are falling out and he looks stressed. I've tried everything but I need a vet's opinion. Could you bring him to the vet and explain his condition? It's urgent.

subject: Critical: Nibbles' Diet Change
body: Nibbles has been losing weight and isn't eating enough. The vet said to switch his diet but I'm not sure which food to choose. Could you help me pick out the right one and bring it over today? It's crucial he gets the right nutrition.

subject: Urgent: Sniffle's Sniffles
body: Sniffle's been sneezing non-stop and looks like he has a cold. He's usually fine with it but this is different. Could you come over and help me decide what to do? This isn't normal and I'm worried.

subject: Urgent: Bella's Barking
body: Bella has been barking uncontrollably and I don't know why. She usually stops when I come home but today she hasn't stopped since morning. I'm really worried and need your help figuring this out today.

subject: Urgent: Hammy's Home Alone
body: I have to leave for a week-long business trip and I don't know how to leave Hammy alone without a cage. Do you have any suggestions or can you look after him while I'm away? I need to make sure he's safe and comfortable.

subject: ASAP: Toto's Teeth
body: Toto's teeth are looking bad and he's not eating properly. The vet said they need to be cleaned, but it's a big bill. Could you help me figure out if it's necessary and how to proceed today? It's important he eats.

subject: Urgent: Whisker's Whimpering
body: Whisker's been whimpering a lot lately and I can't figure out why. He usually plays and is happy but now he's acting differently. Could you come over and help me understand what's going on today? It's worrying.

subject: Critical: Fuzzy's Fainting Spell
body: Fuzzy fainted and I don't know what to do. He's been fine but this morning he passed out and took a while to wake up. Could you please come over and help me figure out what's wrong? We need to act fast.

subject: Urgent: Mittens' Medical Alert
body: Mittens needs an urgent vet visit. She's been vomiting and not eating. I can't leave her alone. Could you take her to the vet? It's critical she gets checked out today.

subject: Urgent: Dog missing
body: My dog went missing this morning. I've searched everywhere but can't find him. Please help me look around your neighborhood. This can't wait, I'm so worried.

subject: Action Required: Cat injured
body: My cat was hit by a car and is severely injured. I need to take her to the vet immediately. Could you cover my shift today? This is critical.

subject: ASAP: Pet sitter needed
body: Our pet sitter just called in sick and my dog has severe separation anxiety. We are leaving for an emergency at 3pm and there's no one to watch him. Could you help? This is urgent.

subject: Urgent: Vet appointment
body: I just got a call from the vet. They found something suspicious during a routine check-up and need to perform an urgent procedure. Can you come with me? We need to be there by 2pm.

subject: This cannot wait: Fish tank trouble
body: My fish tank is leaking and I can't find a plumber. It's a huge mess and I'm worried about the fish. Could you help? I need a solution by the end of the day.

subject: Urgent: Rabbit care
body: Our rabbit is having a hard time eating and seems lethargic. I'm at work but need to take him to the vet soon. Can you please bring him? It's urgent, we need to get him checked today.

subject: ASAP: Dog adoption
body: We're adopting a new dog today but the breeder is asking for more information. Could you call and confirm the adoption? This is urgent, we need to finalize everything before 5pm.

subject: Urgent: Lost pet poster
body: We need to print and distribute posters for our lost dog asap. The printer is down and I'm stuck here. Could you go to the print shop and distribute the posters around the neighborhood? It's urgent.

subject: ASAP: Cat medicine
body: I just got a call from the vet, your cat needs a specific medicine immediately. Could you pick it up and bring it to my house? This is critical, I need it by 6pm.

subject: Urgent: Pet supplies
body: Our pet supplies ran out and I'm stuck here. Could you go to the pet store and get the supplies? It's urgent, we need them before the 3pm meeting.

subject: Action Required: Pet insurance
body: The renewal for our pet insurance is due today and I'm at a meeting. Could you log in and renew it? It's urgent, we need to avoid any penalties.

subject: Urgent: Pet boarding
body: I need to find an emergency pet boarding service. My flight is delayed and I can't bring my cat on the plane. Could you help me find a place? This is urgent, I need a solution by the end of the day.

subject: ASAP: Pet food delivery
body: The delivery for our pet food is overdue and the pet store is closing soon. Could you go and pick it up? This is urgent, we need it for our pet's meal today.

subject: Urgent: Pet health update
body: The vet needs an update on my dog's health status. Could you call and provide the information? This is urgent, we need to avoid any delays.

body: We're adopting a new puppy today but the breeder needs a deposit. Could you call and confirm the adoption? This is urgent, we need to finalize everything by 5pm.

body: Our pet supplies are running low and I'm stuck here. Could you go to the pet store and get the supplies? It's urgent, we need them before the 3pm meeting.

body: The renewal for our pet insurance is due today and I'm at a meeting. Could you log in and renew it? It's urgent, we need to avoid any penalties.

subject: ASAP: Dog training
body: I need to bring my dog to the trainer but I'm stuck in a meeting. Could you take him? It's urgent, we need to get there by 4pm.

subject: Urgent: Pet boarding
body: I need to find an emergency pet boarding service. My flight is delayed and I can't bring my cat on the plane. Could you help me find a place? This is urgent, I need a solution by the end of the day.

subject: Urgent: Missing Pet!
body: Tommy, our cat, escaped during the move yesterday. He's terrified and very sick. Could you help me find him before dusk? Time is running out!

subject: Dog Vet Emergency
body: Our doggy has been vomiting and not eating for two days. Vet says urgent and needs to be in by noon or they'll have to schedule an emergency surgery.

subject: URGENT: Cat Allergy
body: Hi, John! I've developed a severe allergic reaction to our pet cat, and it's escalating. Can we discuss this ASAP? I need your advice immediately.

subject: Action Required: Pet Supplies Overdue
body: We're out of dog food and the supplier is on backorder. Could you order more by the end of the day? The dogs can't wait.

subject: Critical: Pet Sitting Issue
body: Hi, I'm so sorry, but the pet sitter called in sick. She can't make it to the 3pm meeting tomorrow. Could you please find a replacement by tonight? We need a solution NOW!

subject: Urgent: Pet Adoption
body: Hey, can you meet me at the shelter right away? There's a dog that needs a home, and they're closing in an hour. We need to hurry!

subject: ASAP: Pet Boarding Update
body: The boarding kennel for your cat, Fluffy, reported an emergency situation. They need to know by tomorrow if you can pick her up early. Please respond immediately.

subject: Urgent: Dog Bites Incident
body: Dear Colleagues, we've had an incident at the dog park. A dog bit a child. We need to send out an urgent email to the community this afternoon. Can you draft the message and send it ASAP?

subject: Urgent: Pet Health Concerns
body: Our hamster, Chip, has been acting strange. He's been eating less, and his fur looks dull. Can you check on him today? It's concerning.

subject: Production Down: Urgent Fix Needed
body: We've had a critical issue with the new pet food packaging system. Production is down and we need an immediate fix. Can you resolve this by 5pm?

subject: Urgent: Pet Adoption Approval
body: Hi, we have a family that's a perfect match for a dog we're adopting out. They're ready to meet the dog today but we need your approval. Could you reply by 2pm?

subject: Urgent: Pet Owner Eviction Notice
body: I've just received an eviction notice from our landlord. We have to move out by the end of the week. Can you help me find a new place for the cats ASAP?

subject: Urgent: Pet Health Alert
body: There's a serious health alert for our pet fish, Nemo. He's been showing signs of a disease that's spreading rapidly. We need to treat him right away.

subject: Urgent: Pet Caregiver Needed
body: Hi, we have a kitten that needs a lot of care. Our current caregiver is ill and can't help anymore. Can you assist with feeding and playtime over the weekend? It's urgent.

subject: ASAP: Pet Training Issue
body: The dog trainer called to inform us that our dog is struggling with basic commands. They need to review the training methods by the end of the week. Can you coordinate this?

subject: Urgent: Pet Shelter Needs Volunteers
body: Hello, we're running low on volunteers for the pet shelter. We're understaffed and need help with feeding and cleaning. Can you volunteer today?

subject: ASAP: Pet Behavior Report
body: The dog behaviorist wants a report on your dog's progress by tomorrow. Can you provide this ASAP? It's critical for the next session.

subject: Urgent: Pet Supplies Delivery Delay
body: We received an urgent request for pet food delivery, but the delivery service is experiencing a delay. Could you arrange for an alternative delivery before 5pm?

subject: Urgent: Pet Boarding Confirmation
body: Hi, we received a booking confirmation for our dog, Max, but the information is incorrect. Could you confirm the details and make any necessary changes by the end of the day? It's urgent!

subject: ASAP: Pet Health Update
body: The vet just called with a critical update about our rabbit, Thumper. He's not doing well and needs to see a specialist urgently. Can you arrange a consultation today?

subject: Quick - Doggy Door Repair Needed!
body: Hey there! Our neighbor's dog just scratched up the new wood fence. The door to the dog run is jammed and won't close. Could you come over and take a look? It's urgent, the dogs are starting to dig!

subject: ASAP - Emergency Vet Visit Needed
body: Hi, we found your cat wandering near the park. It looks hurt, limping badly and seems in pain. Could you bring it to the vet right away? I'm not sure how long it's been like this, but it's urgent. I'll keep it here until you can come.

subject: Action Required: Missing Pets!
body: We've been searching for our lost pets all day. We think they might be in the woods near the old factory. It's getting dark and we're worried. Could you help us look? This can't wait, the sooner we find them the better.

subject: URGENT: Pet Medication Overdue
body: Hi [Name], we need to get more medication for [pet's name]. The supply is running low and the vet says it must be taken every 4 hours. Could you pick up a new prescription ASAP? This is critical.

subject: For the Love of Pets: Immediate Response Needed
body: Hello, this is a quick message from the local pet shelter. We're in a state of emergency. Our supplies are running out and we need immediate donations of pet food, blankets, and toys. This is for the welfare of the animals. Could you help today?

subject: Urgent: Pet Food Truck Delivery
body: Hi, the delivery for the pet food for next week was supposed to arrive today, but it's not here. We're running low and the warehouse is out. Could you check with the supplier and get a new delivery scheduled? This is urgent.

subject: Urgent: Pet Adoption Process
body: Hi, we just got a call from someone interested in adopting a dog. They're coming in tomorrow at 2 PM. Could you review their paperwork before they arrive? We need to make sure everything is in order. This can't wait.

subject: Quick Help Needed: Pet Boarding Emergency
body: We just took in an extra dog that was abandoned at the park. We don't have enough space in the boarding area and need to move some dogs to make room. Could you help us today? This is urgent.

subject: ASAP: Urgent Pet Care Request
body: Hi, I'm in a bit of a bind. My cat is acting very sick and I need to get her to the vet, but my car is in the shop. Could you come pick her up and take her to the vet asap? This is urgent, I really appreciate any help you can give.

subject: Critical: Pet Shelter Fundraising

subject: Urgent: Pet Care Schedule

subject: ASAP: Pet Food Shortage

subject: Urgent: Pet Adoption Follow-up

subject: ASAP: Pet Care Emergency
body: Hi, we just got a call about a cat that was hit by a car. The owner is on their way with the cat, but they need to be seen by a vet right away. Could you help arrange transport to the vet? This is urgent.

subject: Urgent: Pet Medication Update
body: Hi, the prescription for [pet's name] is due to expire tomorrow. We need to get a refill asap to avoid any lapses in treatment. Could you help with this? This is urgent.

subject: Critical: Pet Care Supplies
body: Hi, we're running very low on pet care supplies. We need to order more collars, leashes, and beds asap. This is urgent, we need to make sure we have enough for all the pets.

subject: ASAP: Pet Boarding Emergency
body: Hi, we have a family coming to pick up their pet at 4 PM, but they're running late. We need someone to stay with the pet until they arrive. Could you help us today? This is urgent.

subject: Urgent: Pet Adoption Assistance
body: Hi, we have a family interested in adopting a cat. Could you help us prepare the adoption paperwork and schedule an appointment for them? This is urgent, we need to make sure everything is in order.

subject: ASAP: Pet Care Staffing
body: Hi, we're short staffed today and need to fill in some shifts. We need someone to cover the morning and evening shifts. This is urgent, we need to make sure the pets are taken care of.

subject: Urgent: Pet Care Emergency
